transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, mostly I’m here because I’m just so tired... but in a way that sleep doesn’t really fix. It’s like even doing simple things, um, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, it just feels like too much right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um, I think it's been... probably about three months now. Yeah, this whole quiet stretch where I just don't have any interest in things and feel so heavy and drained, it's been going on for right around three months.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Um, yeah, I would say so. It's pretty much all day, every day. I just wake up feeling low, and it stays like that. I wouldn't say I'm, like, crying all the time or anything... just really down and flat, pretty constantly.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you normally liked, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Yeah, definitely. Um, I've pretty much stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. Like, I used to do a lot of sketching and going to gallery openings, but I haven't done any of that lately. Same with cooking or doing yoga. Even just going out and playing tennis with a friend... I just don't really have any interest in any of it right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, or found it hard to concentrate on things like work or reading?

Um, yeah, my appetite has definitely been off. Sometimes I'll get to the end of the day and realize all I've had is coffee and maybe just a few bites of food. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but my jeans have gotten noticeably looser lately. As for concentrating... I haven't really noticed it being any harder than usual to read or focus on things. It's mostly just the eating that's changed.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or worthless lately, like you're a burden or that you've failed in some way?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I definitely feel down, but I don't really feel guilty about anything... or like I'm a burden to anyone. I don't really have those kinds of thoughts about being worthless or failing. It's mostly just that flat, empty feeling I mentioned.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still, like you're physically slowed down or restless?

Yeah, um, definitely the moving slowly part. On my slower days, it honestly feels like my body is moving through wet cement. Everything just takes a lot more effort. And it's not just moving around, either... even answering a simple question from my spouse can take me a weirdly long time to just get the words out. I haven't really noticed being restless or having trouble sitting still, though. Just really slowed down.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I've had normal bad days before, sure, but... feeling like this, where everything is just flat and I'm this slowed down? No, this is really the first time I've felt this way. I haven't had a period of time like this before.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or so good that it was out of the ordinary for you, even if it didn't last long?

Yeah, actually, I have. There was a time a while back where... well, for a few weeks I felt unusually lit up. I was just so sure everything was going to be amazing. 

But at the same time, I was really quick to get angry. I would just snap at my husband over really small things, like minor comments he'd make about the budget or the house. So I felt really good and energetic, but I was also just really irritable with him.
How long did that unusually energetic or high period last? Was it at least four days in a row?

Yeah, it definitely lasted at least four days in a row. It was actually a few weeks where I felt like that every single day. It didn't just come and go, it was a constant thing for that whole stretch of time.

During that time when you felt unusually energetic or high, did you also notice things like needing less sleep, talking faster than usual, having racing thoughts, or doing more activities than usual — things that were out of the ordinary for you?

Yeah, definitely the activities part. I had this... just a really restless burst of energy. I kept reorganizing the rooms in the house, making all these lists, and messaging people about different art projects I wanted to start. It was just a lot of doing things at once. And I remember feeling pretty annoyed if anyone wanted me to just sit still or slow down.
Have you ever had any other periods where you felt unusually energetic, high, or irritable that lasted for several days or more?
No, I don't think so. That one time for a few weeks is the only period like that I can really remember. I haven't had any other times where I felt that energetic or irritable for days on end.
